name: cursola
flavor: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

abilities.name: weak-armor
abilities.effect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

abilities.name: perish-body
abilities.effect: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
